what: Screen-sized panels (a different solid background per project + text on the left + a photo on the right) are stacked, and while the section stays pinned to the screen (panel count − 1 screens, scrub .6) the next panel fills up from the bottom edge with clip-path and covers the previous one (one screen per panel, power2.inOut). During the same time the rising panel’s background settles into place from 1.05× and −3%, the photo from 1.06× and +6%, and the text from +12% (power1.out) (background·photo power2.out), giving the depth of a panel sliding in. The index dots light up on the nearest panel number
note: Panel background color comes from the consuming css (bg child or slide). With reduced motion, panels are stacked vertically
